title: Kissed Earthy Syrian Lamb Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Syrian dish featuring lamb, prosciutto, and beurre-monte, perfect for a crowd, this pilaf is earthy, pillowy, and sure to please. It is also gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the beurre-monte in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the basmati rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
